params.name: author_year_start
params.description: Find books with at least one author alive on or after this year. Accepts positive or negative integers (negative for BCE).

params.name: author_year_end
params.description: Find books with at least one author alive on or before this year. Accepts positive or negative integers (negative for BCE).

params.name: copyright
params.description: Filter by copyright status. Comma-separated values among `true` (copyrighted), `false` (public domain in the USA), and `null` (no available copyright information).

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of Project Gutenberg ID numbers to retrieve.

params.name: languages
params.description: Comma-separated two-character language codes. Returns books in any of the listed languages.

params.name: mime_type
params.description: Prefix-matched MIME type. Returns books that have at least one format whose MIME type starts with this value.

params.name: search
params.description: Space-separated keywords searched case-insensitively across author names and book titles. Up to 32 terms are honored.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order. `popular` (default) sorts by download count descending, `ascending` sorts by Project Gutenberg ID ascending, `descending` sorts by ID descending.

params.name: topic
params.description: Case-insensitive key-phrase matched against bookshelf names and subject headings.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of book metadata from the Project Gutenberg catalog. Results are returned 32 per page and can be filtered by author birth/death year, copyright status, Project Gutenberg IDs, languages, MIME type, search keywords, and topic. By default books are sorted by popularity (download count, descending).

params.name: id
params.description: Project Gutenberg ID number of the book.

items.docs: Returns the metadata for a single book identified by its Project Gutenberg ID.
